name: read
description: Read a whole book you own (EPUB or PDF without DRM), a paper, a report or a web article, learn what it teaches, keep notes in a library that lasts, and turn it into a skill you can use from then on. Free, local, no API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a book or article and turn it into a skill
interface.longDescription: Give it a book you own (EPUB or PDF without DRM), a paper, a report or an article link. It reads the whole thing, chapter by chapter for long books, keeps notes in your own words in ~/learning-library, and writes a new skill from them that you read and approve before it is saved. Free, no API keys.
defaultPrompt: Read this: <file or link>. Learn what it teaches and turn it into a skill I can use forever, for <what you want it for>.
Read this paper and turn it into a skill for reviewing my experiments.
What does my library say about hiring?
